answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in jetty, verified in dawn, and copper names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 36 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 3 hours of verification and 14 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
